Oncall Bot: INCIDENT 🚨 detected at 03:12 UTC — p95 latency spike + request errors on hosted inference. Service: runtime-serving-1. Tags: spec-decode, kv-cache, continuous-batching.
Ava K: seeing big latency cliffs on a small set of long-history chat workloads. p95 went from 180ms -> 2.4s in the last 6m.
Diego M: can you paste the error traces?
Ava K: logs attached in the incident runbook. snippet: `runtime: cache eviction flood; speculative_decode: target_miss diverged`
Priya S: customer impact: ~4 customers with heavy convo history show 6-12% of requests hitting 504/timeouts. Others unaffected. Tier: Hosted.
Samir R: I'm paged. jumping in. first guess: speculative decoding sync is writing draft keys that then confuse KV cache eviction heuristics under high batching pressure.
Ava K: agreed. I can repro locally with synthetic replay: when speculative decoding enabled + batch size auto-up, kvcache index gets duplicated prefixes -> cache blowup.
EngOps Bot: Runbook link: <https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/spec-kv-batch|spec-kv-batch> — recommended mitigations: 1) disable speculative decode; 2) reduce max_batch_size; 3) flush kvcache for affected pools.
Samir R: doing step 1 now.
Ava K: step 1 command: `kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/inference-runtime SPEC_DECODE_ENABLED=false`
Diego M: I'm on reducing batching config for pool hosted-gpu-1. Applying config change.
Priya S: I'll message CSMs for the 4 customers and set expectations — low-level engineering detail not needed.
Samir R: applied env toggle. rolling restart started. watching metrics.
EngOps Bot: Deploy Bot: rollout started for deployment inference-runtime in namespace runtime.
Ava K: rolling restart hit restarts=3 -> good. kvcache size metric dropping from 7.8GB -> 650MB on pool hosted-gpu-1. p95 latency recovering.
Diego M: reducing max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 512 for hosted-gpu-1. config snippet:```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 512
  max_batch_items: 32
  batching_strategy: continuous
```
Samir R: also triggered an emergency cache purge for the pool to remove duplicated keys. command: `redis-cli -h kv-host -p 6379 --scan --pattern "spec:*" | xargs redis-cli -h kv-host -p 6379 del` — ran on pool-hosted-gpu-1 at 03:21 UTC.
Priya S: Are fallbacks in place? We should route affected customers to no-cache path while we verify.
Ava K: yes, created routing override to prefer legacy-serving for customer tag:legacy-fallback for affected org_ids. rule pushed at 03:23 UTC.
Samir R: post-mitigation stats: error rate for affected customers dropped from 9.8% -> 0.9% in 6m. p95 latency stabilized ~210ms.
Diego M: would like a safer long-term fix: speculative decode should avoid writing final cache keys until target sync is confirmed. putting an RFC on the board.
Ava K: create a ticket: SPEC-DEC-KV-SYNC with repro, heap profilers, and suggested patch to gate writeback on target-confirmation flag.
Priya S: CSM update: emailed customers with summary + ETA for postmortem. No contractual SLA breaches expected at this time.
EngOps Bot: Incident annotated: mitigation steps executed: disable_spec_decode, reduce_batch_tokens, kvcache_purge, routing_fallback.
Samir R: handoff note to next oncall (Diego): I'm OOO after 04:30 UTC. Leave monitoring alert for kvcache_size > 1.2GB or p95>400ms.
Diego M: taking over monitoring. Will keep the batch cap at 512 until we validate the RFC.
Ava K: adding postmortem owners: Priya (customer impact), Samir (runtime fix), Diego (monitoring + rollout). Target PM for postmortem: EOD tomorrow.
Priya S: tagging customer success threads and legal for visibility.
Samir R: thanks all. closing incident as mitigated at 03:31 UTC — will escalate to P1 if regression observed.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 03:31 UTC — severity reduced to degraded. Link to runbook and actions above.
